answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 35599 Country: India Title: Is commercial broking halal or haram? For example: A person helps another person buy a shop worth 1 lakh in return expects 2000 rupees or 2% of the total Question: Is commercial broking halal or haram? For example: A person helps another person buy a shop worth 1 lakh in return expects 2000 rupees or 2% of the total. Answer ID: 35599 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1904/1351/L=1432) The charge of brokerage is lawful if it is already fixed. This may be fixed as per the percentage. However it is necessary for the agent that he does not tell a lie in selling or buying the goods. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
